name: Category Products Slider for WooCommerce
author: Mofizul Islam

sections.description:
Category Products Slider for WooCommerce allows you to display WooCommerce products by category in a clean, responsive, and customizable slider. You can easily showcase featured or specific category products using a shortcode or a Gutenberg block.

This plugin is ideal for online stores that want to improve product visibility, boost engagement, and enhance the overall shopping experience.

Live Demo:
https://demo.wpalgo.com/category-products-slider-for-woocommerce/

Key Features:

  • Create unlimited product sliders by category
  • Dedicated custom post type for slider management
  • Easy shortcode support: [cpsfwc_slider id="123"]
  • Gutenberg block support
  • Default slider created on plugin activation
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly
  • Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS
  • Template override support for advanced customization

General Settings:
* Slider title and description
* Select WooCommerce product category
* Product image size selection

Display Settings:
* Show or hide product image, title, and price
* Include child categories
* Product limit control
* Custom CSS field

Slider Settings:
* Autoplay with speed control
* Pause on hover
* Navigation arrows and dots
* Lazy loading for better performance
* Column control for desktop, tablet, and mobile
* Loop enable/disable
* Column gap control

Advanced Settings:
* Option to delete plugin data on uninstall
* Duplicate existing sliders easily
sections.installation:
1. Upload the category-products-slider-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Products Slider → Add New.
  4. Configure your slider settings and publish.
  5. Copy the generated shortcode and paste it into any post, page, or widget.
sections.faq:
How do I create a new slider?

After activation, go to Products Slider → Add New in your WordPress dashboard. Configure the slider options and publish.

How do I display the slider on my site?

You can use the generated shortcode or insert the provided Gutenberg block inside any post or page.

Can I customize the slider design?

Yes. You can control layout, autoplay, navigation, columns, and even add custom CSS for advanced styling.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. The plugin is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible WordPress theme.

Is the slider responsive?

Yes. The slider adapts automatically to desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
